decision.explanation: Document d1 states Vaipulu was appointed Senior Advisor to the US President, while document d2 states he currently holds the position of Deputy Prime Minister of Tonga; these are distinct roles in different governments, though the d1 claim regarding a US appointment appears inconsistent with the d2 claim of his current Tongan office.
